command:
/**
 ***************************************************************
 * This macro opens the Date and Time window, where the GM sets
 * the game date and time, the clock speed, the weather and
 * whether conditions skip missing players. The same window is
 * in Game Settings > Forkout 2d20 > Date and Time.
 *
 * Player Hunger, Thirst and Sleep follow the game clock.
 *
 * NOTE: Only users with the Game Master user role can run this
 * macro.
 **************************************************************/

fallout.apps.FalloutDateTime.open();
name: Date and Time (GM)
